description: A shell script that sets up and runs a series of git rebase tests, including creating commits with various message formats, branches, and diffs, and verifying correct behavior of rebase operations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or strings for equality

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command fails

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script

methods.name: set_fake_editor
methods.description: Sets up a fake editor environment for interactive rebase
